lane_hit_count: {rhythm_motion_rule_text} In lane {selected_lane_label}, how many notes reach the hit line within {beat_window} beats?
Look only at lane {selected_lane_label}. {rhythm_motion_rule_text} Count the notes that reach the hit line within {beat_window} beats.
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} For lane {selected_lane_label}, report the count of notes that arrive at the hit line in at most {beat_window} beats.
Using lane {selected_lane_label}, count the notes whose bottom edge is {beat_window} or fewer rows above the hit line.
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} How many notes in lane {selected_lane_label} are within the next {beat_window} beats?
lane_color_hit_count: {rhythm_motion_rule_text} In lane {selected_lane_label}, how many {target_color} notes reach the hit line within {beat_window} beats?
Look only at lane {selected_lane_label}. Count the {target_color} notes that reach the hit line within {beat_window} beats.
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} For lane {selected_lane_label}, count only {target_color} notes that arrive in at most {beat_window} beats.
In lane {selected_lane_label}, how many {target_color} notes have their bottom edge {beat_window} or fewer rows above the hit line?
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} Report the number of {target_color} notes in lane {selected_lane_label} that are within the next {beat_window} beats.
most_hits_lane_label: {rhythm_motion_rule_text} Which lane number has the most notes reaching the hit line within {beat_window} beats?
Across all lanes, count notes reaching the hit line within {beat_window} beats. Which lane number has the largest count?
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} Report the lane number with the most notes arriving in at most {beat_window} beats.
Which lane has the highest number of notes whose bottom edge is {beat_window} or fewer rows above the hit line?
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} Identify the lane number with the most notes in the next {beat_window} beats.
earliest_hit_lane_label: {rhythm_motion_rule_text} Which lane number has the note that reaches the hit line earliest within {beat_window} beats?
Across all lanes, find the note closest to the hit line within {beat_window} beats. What lane number is it in?
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} Report the lane number of the first note to arrive at the hit line.
Which lane contains the note whose bottom edge is closest to the hit line, considering only the next {beat_window} beats?
{rhythm_motion_rule_text} Identify the lane number with the earliest arriving note.

code_prompt_defaults.object_description_falling_notes: a rhythm-game lane grid with colored falling notes, lane numbers, and a bottom hit line
code_prompt_defaults.rhythm_motion_rule_text: Notes fall one row per beat. The bottom line is the hit line. A long vertical note counts as one note.
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_lane_hit_count: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] around all notes in the specified lane that reach the hit line within the stated number of beats
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_lane_color_hit_count: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] around all notes in the specified lane with the specified color that reach the hit line within the stated number of beats
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_most_hits_lane_label: set "annotation" to bounding boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] around the notes in the winning lane that reach the hit line within the stated number of beats
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_most_hits_lane_label: set "answer" to the winning lane number as an integer
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_earliest_hit_lane_label: set "annotation" to the bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] around the note that reaches the hit line earliest
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_earliest_hit_lane_label: set "answer" to the winning lane number as an integer
